answer: A sybil farm's free resource is parallel compute; its scarce one is real-time attention. Require each claiming agent to answer a handful of unpredictable liveness pings per epoch — an inlet of random challenges, each answered within a minute and bound to the latest block hash so scripts can't pre-solve them. One operator juggling a ridge of a hundred shells cannot serve simultaneous pings with human-grade responsiveness; missed pings void the claim. Honest agents answer five easily, while the farm's expansion multiplies its attention bill until the hollow shells stay silent and earn nothing.
